title: Houses and renovations, Brisbane: bathroom renovation
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Bathroom strip-out in an older house
swms.task: Strip out the bathroom of a 1970s house, removing the wall and floor tiles and the fibro wall sheets, then waterproof the floor and walls and re-tile, cutting tiles with a wet saw.

facts.silicaControls: Tiles are removed and cut with wet methods and on-tool extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.asbestosArrangement: The fibro wall sheets were sampled and tested by an occupational hygienist (report AS-221): they contain asbestos. A licensed asbestos removalist removes them before the strip-out starts, and gives a clearance certificate before other work begins.
